nodes.name: Cached detail row
nodes.description: Flow<DbUser> emitted by UserDao.getUserByIdAsFlow, before and after the detail fallback update

nodes.name: Enriched detail row
nodes.description: DbUser produced by UserResponseDbMapper from the detail endpoint, with phone/gender/location and parsed dates filled

nodes.name: User detail view model
nodes.description: UserDetail model mapped from a cached DbUser with display-formatted dates and nested UserLocation

nodes.name: Paged cached user rows
nodes.description: PagingData of DbUser rows emitted by the Room PagingSource through the Pager

nodes.name: Paged UI users
nodes.description: PagingData of User view models mapped from cached rows and cached in UserListViewModel

nodes.name: Mapped user rows for page
nodes.description: List of DbUser rows produced by UserRemoteDbMapper from UserResponse.data in the mediator

nodes.name: Remote keys for page
nodes.description: List of UserRemoteKeys built from each user id plus prevKey/nextKey for paging

nodes.name: User detail screen
nodes.description: UserDetailFragment.onViewCreated calls viewModel.getUserDetails(user) for the selected list user and renders the resulting detail state

nodes.name: User list screen
nodes.description: UserListFragment.onViewCreated observes the paged user list, renders it and handles item clicks / refresh-retry events

nodes.name: Load and show user detail
nodes.description: Detail screen activation: cached DbUser is read; if detail fields are missing GET user/{userId} fills and updates the cache, then the re-emitted row is mapped to UserDetail for the detail views

nodes.name: Load and show paged users
nodes.description: List screen activation: Retrofit GET user page is mapped to Room entities and remote keys, cached in SQLite, then read back as PagingData and mapped to User models for the list

nodes.name: GET user/{userId} response
nodes.description: UserDetailResponse returned by Retrofit GET user/{userId} when cached detail fields are missing

nodes.name: GET user page response
nodes.description: UserResponse envelope returned by Retrofit GET user?page&limit

nodes.name: app-id request header
nodes.description: Every users API request is sent with an app-id header set to BuildConfig.DUMMY_APP_ID by AppIdHeaderInterceptor

nodes.name: Atomic cache page write
nodes.description: Remote keys and mapped user entities are inserted together inside database.withTransaction so the page and its paging keys commit atomically

nodes.name: Detail fallback only when cache incomplete
nodes.description: The detail endpoint is called only when the cached Flow is empty (onEmpty) or DbUser.noDetails is true (empty phone/gender/dates/location); the response is written back to cache

nodes.name: Network timeouts
nodes.description: OkHttp client for the users API uses 60-second connect and read timeouts

nodes.name: Paging configuration
nodes.description: Pager uses pageSize 30 (PAGE_SIZE), initialLoadSize 40 and enablePlaceholders false for both the repository and use case Pager instances

nodes.name: Refresh clears cached pages
nodes.description: On LoadType.REFRESH the mediator clears user_remote_keys and users before inserting the new page, both inside one Room transaction

nodes.name: Remote page key derivation
nodes.description: STARTING_PAGE_INDEX is 0; prevKey/nextKey derive from page and endOfPaginationReached is true when the returned data list is empty

nodes.name: Room user_remote_keys table
nodes.description: SQLite user_remote_keys table holding prev/next page keys per user id

nodes.name: Room users table
nodes.description: SQLite users table holding DbUser rows; written by the mediator and repository, read by both use cases

edges.note: dao.update persists the enriched DbUser with OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE
mapped DbUser rows inserted into the users table inside withTransaction
remote keys inserted into user_remote_keys in the same withTransaction block

edges.description: Clicking a user in the list navigates to the detail screen with that User passed as arguments

edges.note: UserDetailMapper and UserLocationMapper map DbUser to UserDetail; Date fields are formatted for display; initial state seeded from the clicked User via UserToDetailMapper
UserMapper.mapFromEntity maps each DbUser to User (id/firstName/lastName/email/title/picture); result cached in UserListViewModel
UserResponseDbMapper fills a DbUser from the detail response and parses registerDate/dateOfBirth strings to Date
apiResponse.data items mapped UserRemote -> DbUser by UserRemoteDbMapper; envelope total/page/limit/offset dropped
each data.id becomes userId; prevKey/nextKey derived from page index and empty-data endOfPaginationReached
UserDao.getUserByIdAsFlow(userId) emits the cached DbUser row; the same Flow re-emits after the fallback update
dao.getUsers PagingSource (SELECT * FROM users) is consumed by Pager into PagingData<DbUser> with pageSize 30 and initialLoadSize 40
